name: C. Kenntemich
evidence: Identity resolved: C. Kenntemich = Christoph Kenntemich, social psychologist (ostracism / exclusionary decisions), formerly University of Koblenz-Landau / RPTU Landau Social Psychology Lab, later JLU Giessen Work & Organisational Psychology; he is first author of "Digital Echoes of Cultural Values" (SSRN 5041487, with Brueckner-Collet and Selma C. Rudert), which matches the `via` field. No verbatim full address was retrieved: the one WebSearch returned the local part "christoph.kenntemich" with no domain attached, which would require templating a domain -- disallowed. GitHub code search for "Kenntemich" returned only unrelated namesakes (a Warhammer NPC, a Troisdorf street name, journalist Wolfgang Kenntemich, a Bluesky handle) plus a ScienceDaily citation listing him as co-author with Christiane M. Buettner and Kipling D. Williams (identity confirmation only, no email). psy.rptu.de and uni-giessen.de are egress-blocked (connect_rejected), so the team pages could not be read.
